name: dmitryisaenko/larafoundry
description: LaraFoundry — reusable SaaS/CRM core for Laravel (auth, multi-tenancy, RBAC, admin, helpdesk, i18n).

suggest.ext-gd: Required only to process image uploads (avatars, logos) with the default GD image driver; the initials placeholder avatar needs no extension.
suggest.ext-imagick: Alternative image driver — set larafoundry-media.image_driver to 'imagick' to use it instead of GD.
suggest.socialiteproviders/apple: Optional OAuth provider: install it, then add 'apple' to larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers (the core auto-registers the driver from larafoundry.auth.oauth.community_drivers).
suggest.socialiteproviders/microsoft: Optional OAuth provider: install it, then add 'microsoft' to larafoundry.auth.oauth.providers (the core auto-registers the driver from larafoundry.auth.oauth.community_drivers).
suggest.socialiteproviders/linkedin: Optional OAuth provider; note Socialite 5 already ships a native 'linkedin-openid' driver. To use the community one, install it, map its slug under larafoundry.auth.oauth.community_drivers, then add that slug to providers.
suggest.socialiteproviders/twitter: Optional OAuth 2.0 Twitter/X provider (the built-in Socialite 'twitter' driver is OAuth 1.0a). It registers driver name 'twitter', which collides with the native one; resolve the slug (e.g. 'x') before mapping it under larafoundry.auth.oauth.community_drivers and adding it to providers.
